descriptionMarkdown:
This is an updated version of an older blueprint.

It crafts everything that is available on Nauvis except for science packs (over 130 different items in total)

Including belts, inserters, bots, ammunition, etc...

Constructive critique is appreciated ;-)

Input:

        90 iron ore per sec     
        60 copper ore per sec
        30 stone per sec
        30 coal per sec
        15 uranium ore per sec
        200 oil per sec
        water

Edit: It was not possible for me to upload a new image for some reason so the image is outdated.
title: Everything you need for Nauvis 2.0 Mall (Crafts over 130 items from ores to endproduct)
